Msh Mkanah

A serious message, a human story.

The story

“Not Its Place”: an awareness campaign about the dangers of small arms in civilian life.

Client
Danish Refugee Council
Focus
Campaigns

Toucan prepared and launched the campaign on social media for the Danish Refugee Council, using digital illustration, video production and graphic design.

The visual approach was built for an interactive, fast-moving online campaign. The same artwork also supported printed materials for awareness activities on the ground.
